ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Normative Perspect on US Politics. Presents and analyzes key normative debates concerning the operation of the contemporary American political system (institutional deadlock, domination by special interests, under representation of the poor and minorities, fiscal irresponsibility, citizen alienation, the decline of political discourse, an excesses of democracy, etc.) Uses empirical evidence and comparisons with other nations to structure and guide discussion of normative issues. Considers proposals and prospects for political reform.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Political Science major(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
